{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the first few rows after conversion
print(sales_df[['revenue']].head())

# Check the total sum of revenue for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for internal test orders — none mentioned in dictionary, so assume no such flag
# If there were, it would be in the data and we'd see it in value_counts
# Since no mention of test orders, we assume all are real orders

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue_completed}")"}
